note: Temperature Gauge: scroll restored + signal-driven luminos. Chart-area had overflow hidden which blocked two-finger scroll on Mac. Now overflow-y auto with a subtle gold scrollbar so sub-charts below the fold are reachable. Luminos size doubled from 12px to 22px and now driven by CSS variables. The luminos read the latest analysis and translate signal state into visible mood: green when temperature signals buy, red when sell, gold-and-lavender when neutral. Stronger signals make them bigger (32px or 42px). Far from a gravity line adds jitter and faster drift for visible instability. Help people see a clear signal even if they cannot read the chart yet. Plus Escape exits fullscreen so nobody gets stuck and an inline gold-spark favicon kills the 404.
